description: What land is worth around a Texas tract, for pricing an offer. Appraised value per acre of nearby raw-land parcels (county appraisal district market values as published in the TNRIS StratMap parcel collection; improved parcels, where buildings are over 20% of value, are left out): median, 25th and 75th percentile, acre-weighted average, and medians by size band (5-50, 50-200, 200+ acres), plus the subject parcel's own appraisal. Enterprise Lite and Enterprise only (free and Pro get the sample size and a note). Also returns current asking prices of land listed for sale nearby (found by live web search of listing sites such as LandWatch, Land.com and LoopNet, each with its link) and a suggested offer range per acre and for the tract. Texas does not disclose sale prices, so these are appraisals and asking prices, not closed sales. Use for 'what is land worth near X', 'price per acre around this tract', 'what should I offer for this land', 'land comps near'. Free and Pro: how many parcels and acres are in the sample, and what Enterprise Lite adds.

acres.description: Size of the tract being priced, acres, for the offer total. Default: the parcel at the point.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

listings.description: Include nearby asking prices from a live web search (about 10 seconds; Enterprise Lite gets 25 fresh searches a day). Default true.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

min_acres.description: Smallest parcel to include, acres. Default 5.

radius_mi.description: Radius for the appraisal sample, 0.5 to 15 miles. Default 3.

name: land_value
title: Land value near a tract: appraised $/acre, nearby asking prices and an offer range
